mapper.select: SELECT b.tenant_id,b.actor_id,'OPERATOR' role,'WEB' channel FROM central_store_identity_binding b WHERE b.auth_tenant_id=#{tenant} AND b.principal_id=#{principal} AND b.membership_id=#{member} AND b.generation=#{generation} AND b.enabled=TRUE AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_credential c WHERE c.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND c.actor_id=b.actor_id AND c.role='OPERATOR' AND c.active=TRUE AND c.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
